mapper.select: select d.item_code as itemCode, d.storage_qty as storageQty, o.transfer_request_no as transferRequestNo, o.requester_name as requesterName, o.transfer_ship_date as transferShipDate, o.memo as memo, o.transfer_to_wh_cd as transferToWhCd, mw.wh_nm as toWhNm from bss_transfer_order_detail d inner join bss_transfer_order o on o.transfer_request_no = d.transfer_request_no and o.delete_flg = '0' left join mast_warehouse mw on mw.wh_cd = o.transfer_to_wh_cd where d.delete_flg = '0' and d.pallet_no = #{palletNo} and (d.status = #{status} or o.status = #{status}) order by o.transfer_request_no, d.detail_no

select cast(d.id as varchar) as id, d.item_code as itemCode, d.item_name as itemName, d.classification as classification, coalesce(nullif(cl.dict_label, ''), d.classification) as classificationLabel, d.wh_cd as whCd, coalesce(nullif(mw.wh_nm, ''), d.wh_cd) as whName, d.loc_cd as locCd, d.pallet_no as palletNo, d.qty as qty, d.allocation_qty as allocationQty from bss_inventory_detail d left join mast_warehouse mw on mw.wh_cd = d.wh_cd left join sys_dict_data cl on cl.dict_type = 'bss_classification' and cl.dict_value = d.classification where d.delete_flg = '0' and d.status = #{status} and d.qty > coalesce(d.allocation_qty, 0)
and d.wh_cd = #{whCd}
and d.classification in
#{classification}
and d.item_code like concat('%', #{itemCode}, '%')
and d.item_name like concat('%', #{itemName}, '%')
order by d.item_code, d.pallet_no
mapper.insert: insert into bss_transfer_order ( id, transfer_request_no, transfer_fm_wh_cd, transfer_to_wh_cd, status, requester_name, transfer_date, transfer_ship_date, registered_by, registration_date, completed_by, completion_date, memo, delete_flg, create_time, create_by, create_pg_id, update_time, update_by, update_pg_id, version ) values ( #{id}, #{requestNo}, #{sourceWhCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{destWhCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{requester}, #{transferDate}, #{desiredDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{registeredBy}, #{registrationDate}, '', null, #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '0', now(), #{registeredBy}, #{createPgId}, now(), #{registeredBy}, #{createPgId}, 1 )

insert into bss_transfer_order_detail ( id, transfer_request_no, detail_no, status, item_code, item_name, storage_qty, used_qty, lost_damaged_qty, disposal_qty, pallet_no, remarks, delete_flg, create_time, create_by, create_pg_id, update_time, update_by, update_pg_id, version ) values
( #{item.id}, #{item.transferRequestNo}, #{item.detailNo}, #{item.status}, #{item.itemCode}, #{item.itemName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.storageQty}, #{item.usedQty,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{item.lostDamagedQty,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{item.disposalQty,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{item.palletNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.remarks,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '0', now(), #{item.createBy}, #{item.createPgId}, now(), #{item.createBy}, #{item.createPgId}, 1 )
mapper.select: select o.transfer_request_no as requestNo, o.status as status, coalesce(nullif(trim(st.dict_label), ''), o.status) as statusLabel, o.transfer_fm_wh_cd as sourceWhCd, coalesce(nullif(fw.wh_nm, ''), o.transfer_fm_wh_cd) as sourceWarehouse, o.transfer_to_wh_cd as destWhCd, coalesce(nullif(tw.wh_nm, ''), o.transfer_to_wh_cd) as destWarehouse, nullif(o.transfer_date, '') as requestDate, nullif(o.transfer_ship_date, '') as desiredDate, o.requester_name as requester, nullif(o.memo, '') as memo from bss_transfer_order o left join mast_warehouse fw on fw.wh_cd = o.transfer_fm_wh_cd left join mast_warehouse tw on tw.wh_cd = o.transfer_to_wh_cd left join sys_dict_data st on st.dict_type = 'bss_transfer_status' and st.dict_value = o.status where o.delete_flg = '0' and o.transfer_request_no = #{requestNo} limit 1

select d.detail_no as detailNo, d.item_code as itemCode, d.item_name as itemName, d.storage_qty as storageQty, d.used_qty as usedQty, d.lost_damaged_qty as lostDamagedQty, d.disposal_qty as disposalQty, d.pallet_no as palletNo from bss_transfer_order_detail d where d.delete_flg = '0' and d.transfer_request_no = #{requestNo} order by d.detail_no
mapper.update: update bss_transfer_order set transfer_to_wh_cd = #{destWhCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, transfer_ship_date = #{desiredDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, requester_name = #{requester}, memo = #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_pg_id = #{updatePgId}, version = version + 1 where transfer_request_no = #{requestNo} and delete_flg = '0'

update bss_transfer_order_detail set used_qty = #{usedQty,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, update_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_pg_id = #{updatePgId}, version = version + 1 where transfer_request_no = #{transferRequestNo} and detail_no = #{detailNo} and delete_flg = '0'
